description: Utility functions for date parsing, formatting, comparison, timezone handling, and date calculations using 'date-fns' library.

methods.name: freshDate
methods.description: Returns current date with time set to midnight.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Parses a string into a Date object based on a specified format.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string based on a specified format.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if one date string is before another.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if one date string is after another.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Checks if two date strings are equal.

methods.name: numberOfDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns number of days in a given month, optionally discarding leap year.

methods.name: parseTime
methods.description: Parses a time string into a Date object.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a time string.

methods.name: diffInDays
methods.description: Calculates difference in days between two date strings.

methods.name: diffInTime
methods.description: Calculates difference in seconds between two time strings.

methods.name: parseTimeInSeconds
methods.description: Parses a time string into total seconds.

methods.name: setClockInterval
methods.description: Repeatedly calls a callback in sync with system clock at specified interval.

methods.name: getStandardTimezone
methods.description: Converts a float timezone offset into standard GMT string.

methods.name: guessTimezone
methods.description: Guesses current timezone name and offset, defaults if unavailable.
